top_n.note: Rows drawn. A forest plot is read row by row; beyond ~30 it stops being legible.

conf_level.note: Confidence level for intervals derived from a standard error or t-statistic. Explicit CI columns are used as-is.

ref_line.note: The null. 0 for a log fold-change or coefficient; 1 for an unlogged ratio.

catalog.summary: Forest plot of effect sizes with confidence intervals — one row per feature, a reference line at the null, and colour by whether the interval clears it. Takes a DE / model-results table and uses its explicit CI columns, its standard error, or its t-statistic (in that order, and says which).
